americanoperator-americanoperator:ashbyh.title: Portfolio CEO: Tent & Event Rental Company
americanoperator-americanoperator:ashbyh.description: ABOUT AMERICAN OPERATOR American Operator exists to keep the American Dream alive through small-business leadership and ownership. We place experienced operators into businesses of retiring owners who want their life's work placed in the hands of leaders who care. Over time, our CEOs follow a clear pathway to earn significant equity in the business they lead. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for an experienced operator to lead a tent & event supplies rental company as CEO in partnership with American Operator. This is a rare opportunity to step into a profitable, established business with a strong reputation, loyal customer base, and an experienced team already in place. As CEO, you'll assume full responsibility for day-to-day operations, team leadership, and P&L performance. This is not a turnaround situation, it's an opportunity to build on a solid foundation. Your focus will be on developing and retaining a great team, driving customer acquisition and growth, executing with operational discipline, and scaling the business from a position of strength. American Operator will be your partner from day one, providing strategic support, resources, and guidance while empowering you to lead independently. Most importantly, you'll have a clear path to earning significant equity ownership in the business you grow and lead. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Grow the business with a focus on key performance metrics as you lead day-to-day operations - Develop and lead sales, field crew leaders, and office staff with a culture of high accountability and performance - Coach and build an outbound sales team focused on corporate relationships and referral partners - Manage the budget and capital decisions associated with a relatively asset-intensive business - Adapt the business's sales, marketing, and inventory based on the latest trends in weddings, corporate events, graduations, etc. - Recruit, manage, and develop field teams in a physically challenging industry with seasonality - Partner with American Operator on strategy, budgeting, and growth planning REQUIREMENTS - 10+ years of leadership experience with direct experience as a sales and operations leader - Experience building high performance teams with accountability for hiring and performance improvement - Track record of leading and growing an organization that's driven by local relationships and referral networks WHAT SETS YOU APART - A competitive spirit that always finds a way to win - Experience as a sales or operations leader in the catering, event planning, or rental industry - Stepped in as the new leader after an ownership or leadership transition and earned the trust of a long-tenured team - Military leadership experience COMPENSATION Base salary: $150,000, plus performance-based bonus opportunities, distributions, and meaningful equity participation beginning at 10% ownership, with the potential to increase based on performance and value creation. Total compensation varies by portfolio company, individual performance, and deal structure, and includes a comprehensive benefits package. LOCATION This opportunity is located in the greater Philadelphia metro area. The exact location of this business will be revealed during the interview process. Relocation will be required if you are not currently in or near the market of the opportunity. Ready to lead the next chapter? Before you apply, we encourage you to visit americanoperator.com http://americanoperator.com to learn more about who we are, how we work, and what our operators have to say about the experience. When you are ready, apply today to start the conversation.

assistworld-assist-world:lever:0ea489e6-.title: Shopify Manager (Ecommerce & B2B)
assistworld-assist-world:lever:0ea489e6-.description: Company Overview This is lighting company with locations in Surrey, B.C., Las Vegas, NV, Greenville, SC, and Carlsbad, CA. The brand operates three Shopify websites: two shoppable e-commerce sites and one online catalog site for wholesale trade partners. Role Overview The company is looking for an experienced, hands-on Shopify professional to manage and support all three of their Shopify sites. This is not a purely task-execution role — the client wants someone resourceful and solutions-oriented who can proactively spot issues and opportunities, recommend improvements, and help evolve the sites' functionality, aesthetics, and overall user experience over time. Key Responsibilities • Manage and support three Shopify websites: two e-commerce storefronts and one wholesale catalog site. • Maintain and continuously improve site functionality, design/aesthetics, and overall user experience. • Proactively identify issues and opportunities on the sites and recommend solutions rather than waiting to be assigned tasks. • Handle large product launches, approximately twice a year, uploading and managing around 500 products per launch with strong accuracy and attention to detail. • Support and help scale the B2B/wholesale trade program on the two Shopify Plus sites, including B2B pricing structures and customer-specific experiences. • Manage site functionality that displays different products, pricing, or content depending on customer login status and customer type. • Help plan for and eventually support the launch of Canadian e-commerce functionality. • Collaborate regularly with the Sales and Marketing teams, including joining calls as needed. Skills & Tools — Must-Haves • Strong hands-on experience managing Shopify sites, including Shopify Plus. • Experience with complex B2B ecommerce structures: tiered/customer-specific pricing, gated or login-based content and pricing, and wholesale functionality. • Comfortable working within a dynamic, evolving B2B setup and helping scale it over time. • Experience with large-scale product uploads and catalog management, with strong attention to detail. • Resourceful, solutions-oriented, and comfortable proactively sharing recommendations rather than only executing assigned tasks. • Strong communication skills and comfort collaborating directly with Sales and Marketing stakeholders. Skills & Tools — Nice-to-Haves • Experience with international or multi-market Shopify setups (multiple currencies/regions), given the upcoming Canadian e-commerce launch. • Prior experience specifically supporting a Shopify Plus B2B/wholesale trade program.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:646d229a-b995-.title: Enterprise Implementation Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:646d229a-b995-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Enterprise Implementation Manager based in United States. This role serves as the primary point of accountability for a portfolio of enterprise healthcare customers from implementation through long-term partnership. You will lead complex onboarding initiatives, including technical integrations, data connector builds, configuration, validation, and go-live activities. Beyond delivery, you will build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and help organizations maximize the value they realize from a healthcare data platform. The position combines customer success, project management, technical coordination, account governance, and strategic advisory responsibilities. You will collaborate closely with engineering, data, health platform, growth, and retention teams to keep initiatives aligned and risks visible. Success means delivering high-quality outcomes, strengthening account health, driving adoption, and helping customers achieve measurable business and healthcare objectives. The role is ideal for a relationship-oriented operator who can navigate technical complexity while confidently engaging operational, clinical, and executive stakeholders. Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts as the primary point of contact and accountability throughout implementation and the ongoing customer relationship. Lead customer onboarding, implementation, and technical delivery workstreams from kickoff through validation and go-live, ensuring commitments remain on schedule and within scope. Project-manage new data connector builds, platform configuration, data orchestration, and related integration activities. Lead recurring client meetings, status updates, Quarterly Business Reviews, Executive Business Reviews, and steering committees, communicating progress, risks, decisions, and next steps clearly. Build and maintain trusted relationships with executive, operational, clinical, and technical stakeholders while developing a strong understanding of each customer's business priorities. Monitor account health using customer usage, engagement, feedback, and other relevant signals, maintaining accurate health scores and proactively addressing risks to retention. Identify, escalate, and resolve delivery and account risks using established processes and playbooks before they threaten customer outcomes or momentum. Coordinate dependencies across internal teams, third parties, engineering, data teams, and customer stakeholders to maintain alignment and efficient execution. Partner with growth and retention teams on renewal and expansion activities by providing account context, delivery insight, and relationship continuity while commercial ownership remains with the appropriate team. Connect implementation activities to broader adoption, value realization, ROI, and customer success objectives. Identify opportunities to improve workflows, processes, documentation, and delivery consistency, sharing lessons learned and best practices across the team. Contribute to customer feedback initiatives, including CSAT and NPS programs, and use customer insights to improve engagement and outcomes. Support coaching and informal mentoring of less experienced team members through knowledge sharing and practical guidance. Thoughtfully use AI and emerging technologies to improve account analysis, documentation, QBR preparation, efficiency, and decision-making while maintaining appropriate standards for privacy, security, and quality. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field. At least 3 years of experience leading account implementation and customer success processes within software or technology environments, ideally in healthcare. Experience with healthcare data integration, particularly claims and clinical data, is highly valuable. Strong knowledge of project management and customer success principles, methodologies, tools

jobgether-jobgether:lever:867d1d03-697b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Python/Django) based in United States. Join a fast-growing, international technology environment where your backend expertise will directly support a global connectivity platform. You will build and scale high-performance APIs and mission-critical microservices used by millions of travelers worldwide. The role combines hands-on backend engineering with software architecture responsibilities, particularly around operations, automation, and scalability. You will help strengthen engineering quality through testing, code reviews, documentation, and modern development practices. Working closely with Product and QA teams, you will turn complex business requirements into resilient and maintainable solutions. You will also have the opportunity to tackle technical debt and performance challenges in a high-load environment. Design and develop scalable APIs capable of supporting high-concurrency traffic and significant usage peaks. Contribute to software architecture, with a particular focus on operations, automation, resilience, and scalable engineering practices. Identify and resolve technical debt, performance bottlenecks, inefficient database queries, N+1 problems, and asynchronous processing issues. Improve application performance and reliability through profiling, optimization, and appropriate asynchronous programming techniques. Work closely with Product, QA, and other engineering stakeholders across international teams to translate business requirements into maintainable technical solutions. Champion software engineering best practices across the development lifecycle, including design patterns, technical documentation, code reviews, and maintainability. Contribute to continuous improvement and automation initiatives, helping create efficient and scalable development and operational processes. Act as a technical reference for backend engineering and contribute strategic thinking while remaining hands-on with implementation. Requirements 5+ years of professional backend development experience , with strong expertise in Django and Django REST Framework. Advanced proficiency in Python , with a solid understanding of backend architecture and production software development. Proven experience designing and building microservices architectures and integrating complex third-party applications or ecosystems. Strong experience with unit testing and quality-first development practices, including Pytest or comparable testing frameworks. Practical experience with asynchronous programming and optimizing high-load database queries. Demonstrated ability to identify performance issues and improve application efficiency, scalability, and reliability. Strong understanding of API design, software architecture, design patterns, and maintainable code practices. matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:990882fc-4d0.description: Our Mission As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing. We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more. Our Values Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down. Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today. Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate. Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same. Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us. Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters. The Engineering team is responsible for building innovative features and resilient systems that bring people together. We're always experimenting with new features to engage with our members. Although we are a high-scale tech company, the member-to-engineer ratio is very high—making the level of impact each engineer gets to have at Tinder enormous. As a Backend Engineer at Tinder, you will have an outsized impact and ownership of the most visible aspects of the Tinder App. We are deeply invested in challenging norms, constantly improving architecture design, exploring emergent tech and ideas, and leveraging new technologies in interesting ways to deliver an app that is widely known the world over.

qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:fbe2fc85-fd62-4c0c.title: Aircraft Stress Engineer
qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:fbe2fc85-fd62-4c0c.description: Aircraft Structural Stress Analyst Location: Newport News, VA Job Type: Contract-to-Hire Starting Pay: $55/hour, with higher pay available based on experience Position Overview Seeking a Stress Analyst to perform structural analysis and engineering substantiation for aircraft structures and mechanical systems involved in modifications, repairs, integration, and certification programs. The role evaluates strength, stiffness, fatigue, damage tolerance, vibration, and airworthiness requirements while supporting engineering documentation and certification activities.
responsibilities: Perform structural evaluations for aircraft modifications, repairs, and mechanical installations.
Analyze static strength, fatigue, damage tolerance, vibration, thermal effects, and other structural requirements.
Develop load paths, free-body diagrams, analytical models, engineering assumptions, and supporting calculations.
Prepare stress reports, engineering reports, margin of safety calculations, substantiation packages, and compliance documentation.
Review drawings, designs, and proposed modifications for structural integrity, manufacturability, maintainability, and regulatory compliance.
Support FAA, military, customer, and other applicable certification or airworthiness requirements.
Assist with certification documentation, compliance reports, test plans, and technical data.
Work with Mechanical, Electrical, Certification, Production, Quality, and other engineering personnel to resolve technical issues.
Provide engineering support during fabrication, assembly, installation, troubleshooting, testing, and aircraft modification activities.
Participate in design reviews and provide recommendations related to structural safety, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
Maintain analyses and engineering documentation under configuration control and company procedures.
Contribute to improved analysis methods, engineering standards, and lessons learned.
Perform additional engineering duties as assigned.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering field from an accredited institution.
Experience conducting structural analysis and engineering substantiation for aircraft, aerospace products, mechanical systems, or similar applications.
Knowledge of structural mechanics, materials, fatigue, damage tolerance, vibration, FEA, classical hand calculations, and analytical evaluation methods.
Experience preparing engineering analyses, stress reports, margin of safety calculations, and compliance documentation.
Familiarity with aerospace materials, manufacturing methods, fastener systems, composite structures, and aircraft repair practices.
Experience with engineering analysis software such as ANSYS, FEMAP, NASTRAN, Abaqus, Mathcad, or comparable tools.
Strong written, verbal, analytical, and organizational skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
Ability to work in both office and aircraft hangar environments.
U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Resident status.
Familiarity with configuration management, engineering release procedures, and aerospace quality systems such as AS9100.
Experience working with customers, DERs, FAA representatives, OEMs, suppliers, or certification authorities.

summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we need? The Entry Ride Operator is the conductor and entertainer for our members while making sure all vehicles are being processed safely and efficiently into the car wash tunnel. The Entry Ride Operator interacts with all customers and is responsible for exterior site cleanliness and creating a memorable experience in all interactions while preparing the vehicles prior to entering the car wash tunnel. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated, have an outgoing, and a friendly personality. We will provide extensive hands-on and online training for all team members.
responsibilities: Speak/Sing into microphone or headset
Entertain customers and members
Points to directional signs while watching the customer to ensure directions are followed
Maintain a safe and clean work area; keep alert for potential hazards
Mechanical aptitude or knowledge a plus
Other duties as assigned

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:38983c67-29b.title: Alpheratz Project - Danish (Denmark) Translation Quality Rater
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:38983c67-29b.description: We are looking for experienced language professionals to support an ongoing project focused on reviewing and refining Danish (Denmark) Translation Quality Rater customer service content. This role involves improving machine-translated materials to ensure accuracy, natural language, and alignment with project guidelines. What you’ll do Edit and review machine-translated customer service content with a high level of accuracy and consistency. Evaluate MT output quality and apply severity ratings when required, following project guidelines. Produce high-quality human translations as reference data for model training and quality evaluation. Follow provided style guides, tone rules, and terminology requirements. Identify and report recurring MT quality issues and batch-level trends. Project details Language: Danish (Denmark) Content type: Customer service content (general) Project duration: OngoingThis role involves intermittent work, with tasks assigned on an ad hoc basis throughout the year depending on client needs. Volumes and timing may vary. Hourly rate: $30
qualifications: Native proficiency in Danish (Denmark).
Experience in translation, localization, or MT post-editing.
Familiarity with machine translation quality evaluation and error identification.
Strong attention to detail and a quality-focused mindset.
Ability to work independently in an online environment.
